title: Fix data race in overrun warning parameter by Quchaosheng · Pull Request #3619 · ros-controls/ros2_control · GitHub
body_rendered_text:
Cache overruns.print_warnings in an atomic so the real-time write loop does not read the parameter snapshot while diagnostics refresh it.


Fixes #3612.
